critical_code_review_comments: webhooks_router.py: GET /api/webhooks/events is unauthenticated and exposes raw event payloads — fine for dev/diagnostics but should be admin-gated before production

accounting_router.py balance_sheet: capital_and_reserves is computed as (total_assets - total_liabilities) plug, which makes totals_match always true by construction. This is acceptable for an aggregation layer but means the BS cannot detect real bookkeeping errors. Document this limitation or add a separate 'retained earnings' calc from P&L period

accounting_router.py trial_balance: the trial balance won't actually balance in this aggregation model (e.g., Sales credit has no offsetting Debtors/Cash debit booked unless invoice was paid). 'difference' will be non-zero on most real data — UI should display this clearly rather than imply mismatch is an error

tours_router.py + transport_router.py: profit is computed on-the-fly in list endpoints but NOT persisted on the document. Consider storing profit at create time to avoid recomputing on every read (minor perf)

services_router.py list_amc: mutates status in-memory after fetch but never writes back to DB — so DB status stays whatever was last set. If you want true persistence of expiring_soon/expired, run a daily job or update on read
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ (expenses, tickets, AMCs, packages, bookings, vehicles, trips) created in fresh registered tenants (TEST_it5_*@aitax.in) for isolation testing. Demo tenant got 1 expense + 1 ticket + 1 AMC + 1 package + 1 vehicle from UI run (visible in screenshots).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 is fully green. Backend test suite is now 74 tests across 4 files (test_aitax_regression.py iter2, test_iteration3_admin_auth.py, test_iteration4_gst_pdf_pos_multicompany.py, test_iteration5_accounting_webhooks_ops.py) — runs in ~75s. Valid subscription plan IDs are 'starter' and 'pro' (NOT 'professional'). /api/auth/me UserOut model does NOT include subscription_status — use /api/subscription/status which returns {plan, status, expires_at, billing_cycle}. Webhook secret RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is intentionally unset in dev — production must set it. Note: trial_balance.difference is expected to be non-zero on real data due to aggregation-layer design (see code review comments).
